entities.summary: Gian Franco Bottazzo was an Italian physician who spent most of his career in London. He was a prominent researcher in the field of diabetes and autoimmunity, and demonstrated that type 1 diabetes is associated with antibodies against beta cells. Gian Franco Bottazzo was a physicians & medical pioneers from Venice (1946-08-01, Venice–2017-09-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
